why: Generation 47928d7e cost 1,580 credits and was rejected because Marble
reproduced the Relay Dogs out of the reference image, despite an explicit
NO-DOGS instruction in the text prompt. Image conditioning beat the
negative. The fix was to crop above the dog band — but nothing STOPPED the
full reference being used again, and a text prompt saying 'no dogs' had
already been shown not to work.
So this file is the gate. An image may be used to condition a paid Marble
generation only if it is listed here as dog-free, and only if its bytes
still hash to what was attested. Nothing in this repository can LOOK at an
image and decide — this records that a person did, which file they looked
the_rule: Marble supplies the BACKDROP. Relay Dogs are authored Unreal assets placed after and over it. An image containing Dogs must never condition a generation, because what Marble copies out of it is unremovable scenery.

wonderland-backdrop-nodogs.jpg.attested_by: the agent, from the crop geometry
wonderland-backdrop-nodogs.jpg.how: ffmpeg crop=1672:428:0:0 of the 1672x941 founder reference. The Dogs occupy the lower plaza band; the crop keeps only the top 428 rows, which end above them. This is a geometric fact about the crop, not a visual judgement of the output.

wonderland-reference.jpg.how: The canonical reference. Its whole lower half is Relay Dogs arranged around the hero on the arcane circle — that is the point of the image.
wonderland-reference.jpg.note: LISTED SO IT IS REFUSED, not so it is available. This is the image that cost 1,580 credits. It remains the art-direction authority and must never condition a generation.
